notes: Bigger and Fatter: Polymarket US joins Kalshi as a second exchange. Open it from the tab on the edge of the window: browse Polymarket US’s live 15-minute BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP markets, and test your strategy and the Litter Box models there with fake money, on its real prices. Each exchange is its own workspace with its own balance, bets, history and fake-money results. Switching changes only what you’re looking at; your layout, sidekick, text size and shortcuts work in both. What works on Polymarket US: every strategy is checked against both exchanges’ published market rules (same 15-minute windows, the same CF Benchmarks price index, the same settlement rule) and marked Works, Partly or Not available with a one-line reason, such as “Polymarket US has no 15-minute DOGE market”.
